//: Secrets are NOT stored here. Every empty value below must be supplied at deploy time as an environment variable (ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection, Jwt__Key, Bootstrap__AdminPassword, ...) or from a secret manager. The previous ${VAR} placeholders were never expanded by .NET configuration and were read as literal strings.

Database.//: Run migrations as a separate release step: EF Core's Migrate() is not safe to run from several instances at once.

Bootstrap.//: Used once per role, only when nobody holds that role yet. Admin and support cannot be registered for in the app, so this is how the first of each is created. Supply the values at deploy time (Bootstrap__AdminEmail, Bootstrap__AdminPassword, Bootstrap__SupportEmail, Bootstrap__SupportPassword) — a password written into this file would be a login for every copy of this repository.

Payments.//: Startup fails in Production unless this is true, so the simulator gateway is never mistaken for a real integration.

AzureStorage.//: Startup fails in Production unless ConnectionString or AccountName is supplied at deploy time (AzureStorage__ConnectionString / AzureStorage__AccountName). Prefer AccountName plus a managed identity holding 'Storage Blob Data Contributor' — there is then no key to leak or rotate.
